# Load the data
```{r}
load("./data/ratings.Rdata")
```
# Compute Covariance
```{r}
S1 <- cov(ratings)
S1
```
# Installing packages
```{r}
install.packages("ggm")
BiocManager::install("graph")
require(ggm)
```

#  Computing Partial Correlation using ggm package
```{r}
C1<-parcor(S1)
round(C1,3)
```

# Installing packages
```{r}
install.packages("corrplot")
require(corrplot)
```

```{r}
corrplot(C1, type = c("upper"))
```
